## Try It Out!
### Send digital download link after Sharetribe purchase via Gmail

Automatically email a download link to buyers after their purchase payment is confirmed. Perfect for digital product marketplaces selling files, templates, courses, or software.

### How it works
* The Sharetribe Trigger polls for `transaction/transitioned` events.
* An IF node filters for the `transition/confirm-payment` transition.
* The Asset Get node retrieves your marketplace's email template text for download delivery.
* Gmail sends the buyer an email with the download link.

### How to set up
1. Connect your Sharetribe credentials (Client ID and Client Secret from Console > Build > Applications).
2. Connect your Gmail account.
3. Update the email body with your download link logic. The download URL could come from listing metadata, a file hosting service, or a generated link.
4. Activate the workflow.

### Requirements
* Sharetribe marketplace with Integration API credentials
* Gmail account
* Digital products with download links stored in listing metadata or external service

### How to customize
* Add a Sharetribe Get Listing node to fetch the download URL from listing publicData/metadata.
* Add an HTTP Request node to generate time-limited download links from your file hosting (S3, Google Drive, etc.).
* Send a separate email to the provider requesting they share files.
* Add download tracking via Google Sheets.

Need help? Visit the [n8n Community](https://community.n8n.io/) or [Sharetribe Docs](https://www.sharetribe.com/docs/).

## 1. Listen for transitions
Polls for `transaction/transitioned` events with the full resource for customer and listing details.

## 2. Filter for payment
Only delivers downloads after payment is confirmed, preventing premature access.

## 3. Get email text & deliver
Retrieves marketplace email copy and sends the download email to the buyer.
